blocks.orig: 8 DAYS FLY SAFARI RUAHA AND NYERERE NATIONAL PARK
blocks.html: 8-day fly safari to Ruaha and Nyerere National Park

blocks.orig: Nyerere National Park (previously called Selous Game Reserve) and Ruaha National Park are the largest national parks and certainly the highlights of Tanzania’s South. They are located a great distance apart from each other, and therefore it would take too long to drive by car from one park to the other. For that reason, we designed this safari combination with convenient and short inland flights. This safari route is often used as an extension of a safari to the northern parks.
blocks.html: The highlights of southern Tanzania are without doubt Nyerere National Park (formerly known as Selous Game Reserve) and Ruaha National Park, which are also the country’s largest national parks. Because the two parks lie far apart, driving from one to the other would take too much time. That is why we put this safari combination together with short, convenient domestic flights. Travellers often add this safari route to a safari in the northern parks.

blocks.orig: This private safari offers you the flexibility to travel at your own pace, exactly the way you like it. You will have a private safari vehicle and guide.
blocks.html: On this private safari you are free to travel at the pace you prefer, just the way you want. You have your own safari vehicle and your own guide.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we hear a lot is when you should travel to Tanzania. Honestly, there is no single correct answer. It comes down to what you hope to see, the places you want to visit, your budget and what interests you. You can read our detailed guide on the best time to travel to Tanzania here.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: On a safari with us you get the chance to discover Tanzania’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful scenery. Private safaris are our speciality, so the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is yours alone. You choose when each safari day begins and finishes, and our experienced guides are happy to help you decide on the day itself. Perhaps you want to see the animals when they are most active around sunrise and sunset, when it is pleasantly cool, or perhaps you would rather finish the afternoon at the pool: the choice is yours. Because animals in Tanzania are active at different times of day, you will have many chances to see them in action.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo can all be seen in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and friendly country for travellers. You will find a hospitable atmosphere, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, and you can enjoy the scenery and wildlife with peace of mind. People are welcoming, and as anywhere else in the world it is sensible to take normal precautions, such as watching your belongings. With its natural beauty and warm people, Tanzania is a wonderful country to visit.

blocks.html: Welcome to Tanzania! When you land at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly and well-informed guide will be looking forward to greeting you. Lean back and relax while we look after all your travel arrangements, so that your time in Tanzania becomes an experience to remember.

blocks.orig: Nyerere National Park is a huge and beautiful national park in the south of Tanzania, boasting a river, a jungle, and a large number of animals such as lions, leopards, hippos, crocodiles, Maasai giraffes and even a few black rhinos and African wild dogs. From Dar Es Salaam you fly to this amazing park, where you can do safaris by car, boat, or foot. The Rufiji River, which crosses the entire reserve, and the massive Stiegler Gorge are not to be missed!
blocks.html: In the south of Tanzania lies Nyerere National Park, a vast and beautiful park with a river, a jungle and many animals, including lions, leopards, hippos, crocodiles, Maasai giraffes and even a small number of black rhinos and African wild dogs. You fly here from Dar Es Salaam, and in the park you can go on safari by car, by boat or on foot. Be sure not to miss the Rufiji River, which runs right through the reserve, or the enormous Stiegler Gorge!

blocks.orig: A boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere National Park is both relaxing and adventurous! The boat takes you over the river and to nearby lakes, allowing you to spot many animals that come to the water’s edge. Very common are giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, kudus and warthogs. Sometimes, also bathing elephants or crocodiles can be seen, and always, the many bird species sound their voices. The trip includes a picnic lunch on the shores of one of the lakes.
blocks.html: Going on a boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere National Park is relaxing and adventurous at the same time. The boat carries you along the river and on to lakes nearby, so you can see the many animals that come down to the water. Giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, kudus and warthogs are seen very often. At times you may also see elephants bathing or crocodiles, and the many bird species can always be heard. A picnic lunch on the shore of one of the lakes is part of the trip.

blocks.orig: This morning you board a small aircraft and fly to Ruaha National Park. It is a short flight, which makes it possible to do a first game drive right upon arrival! Ruaha National Park is the third largest national park in Tanzania. It lies along the Great Ruaha River, is known for its large elephant population, and is a true paradise for birdwatchers. Game drives are special, as you drive through an untouched and unexplored ecosystem in this relatively quiet but stunning park!
blocks.html: This morning a small aircraft takes you to Ruaha National Park. Because the flight is short, you can head out on your first game drive as soon as you arrive. Ruaha National Park is Tanzania's third largest national park. Located along the Great Ruaha River, it is famous for its large elephant population and is a real paradise for birdwatchers. Game drives here feel special, because you travel through an untouched and unexplored ecosystem in this fairly quiet yet beautiful park!

blocks.orig: Ruaha National Park is the third largest national park in Tanzania. It lies along the Great Ruaha River, is known for its large elephant population, and is a true paradise for birdwatchers with over 570 species. Besides, you might catch a glimpse of lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals, or the rare African wild dog. Game drives are special, as you drive through an untouched ecosystem in this relatively quiet but stunning park!
blocks.html: Tanzania's third largest national park is Ruaha National Park. Located along the Great Ruaha River, it is famous for its large elephant population and, with more than 570 species, is a real paradise for birdwatchers. You may also see lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals or the rare African wild dog. Game drives here feel special, because you travel through an untouched ecosystem in this fairly quiet yet beautiful park!

blocks.orig: This is your last day! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, from where you will catch your international flight home. Having second thoughts? Then don't hesitate to extend your holiday to one of Tanzania's paradise islands such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day has arrived! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, where you board your international flight home. Not ready to leave yet? Then feel free to extend your holiday on one of Tanzania's paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
